description: Utility functions for Playwright browser automation, including request handling, event waiting, and filename generation.

methods.name: waitForCompletion
methods.description: Waits for a callback to complete while monitoring network requests, handling navigation and response promises.

methods.name: callOnPageNoTrace
methods.description: Executes a callback on a Playwright page without tracing.

methods.name: dateAsFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename string based on the current date and provided extension.

methods.name: eventWaiter
methods.description: Waits for a specific event on a Playwright page with timeout and provides an abort method.
